title: Epona’s Song
hook: Complete taught phrase: D-B-A twice (the in-game ocarina song), then D-B-A-B and the long closing A

evidence.level: two-MIDI exact pitch/onset comparison, a third sequence, the decompiled game note table and the official Nintendo score for the six in-game notes
evidence.summary: VGMusic lzepona2_2.mid track 1 (ocarina, program 79) events 0-10 (96 BPM, 3/4) vs Zelda5.mid track 3 events 0-10 (85 BPM, +12): 11 pitches and metrical attacks identical. bitmidi 112964, an ocarina-only file that ends after these same eleven notes, agrees within 0.023438 beat (+12). zeldaret/oot 14759ab sOcarinaSongNotes[OCARINA_SONG_EPONAS] decodes D5 B4 A4 D5 B4 A4 (+12 = MIDI D6 B5 A5 ...) at 18/18(+1)/72/18/18/144 frames (an eighth is 18 frames): attacks within 1 frame. Nintendo's official score of the song (3/4: two eighths and a dotted quarter, twice) has the same six pitches and attacks. The table and the score hold only the six in-game notes; events 6-10 rest on the MIDIs.

title: Song of Storms
hook: Complete taught phrase: D-F-D twice (the in-game ocarina song), then E-F-E-F-E-C-A and the answers A-D-F-G-A and A-D-F-G-E

evidence.level: two-MIDI exact pitch/onset comparison, three further sequences, the decompiled game note table and the official Nintendo score for the six in-game notes
evidence.summary: VGMusic Windmill.mid track 5 (flute, program 73) events 0-22 (200 BPM, 3/4) vs kkrikwnd.mid track 5 events 0-22 (133 BPM, dotted-quarter beats; x1.5): 23 pitches and metrical attacks identical. z64inwml, sngofstrms and windmill_hut2 (+12) have the same 23 pitches and attacks. zeldaret/oot 14759ab sOcarinaSongNotes[OCARINA_SONG_STORMS] decodes D4 F4 D5 D4 F4 D5 (+12 = MIDI D5 F5 D6 ...) at 11/11(+1)/45/11/11/90 frames (a 3/4 bar is 68 frames): attacks within 0.666667 frame. Nintendo's official score of the song (3/4: two eighths and a half note, twice) has the same six pitches and attacks. The table and the score hold only the six in-game notes; events 6-22 rest on the MIDIs. The complete phrase reaches F6, one semitone above the configured range, so the uniform shift is not zero.

title: Serenade of Water
hook: Complete taught phrase: D-F-A-A-B (the in-game ocarina song), then the answer A-D-F-G-F-E-G and the closing F#

evidence.level: two-MIDI exact pitch/onset comparison, two further sequences, the decompiled game note table and the official Nintendo score for the five in-game notes
evidence.summary: VGMusic Sofw.mid (Freddy Meijer) track 1 (ocarina, program 79; the whole 13-note line, no overlaps) events 0-12 (96 BPM, 3/4) vs Sirius64 z5serenade.mid track 1 events 0-12 (90 BPM): 13 pitches and metrical attacks identical. Tyler Prevost's sequence without its 0.0156-beat artifact agrees within 0.015625 beat; Serenade_of_Water.mid, a whole tone lower (+2), is identical. zeldaret/oot 14759ab sOcarinaSongNotes[OCARINA_SONG_SERENADE] decodes D4 F4 A4 A4 B4 (+12 = MIDI D5 F5 A5 A5 B5) at 36/36(+1)/33/(3 rest)/36/144 frames (a quarter is 36 frames): attacks within 1 frame. Nintendo's official score of the song (3/4: four quarters and a half note) has the same five pitches and attacks. The table and the score hold only the five in-game notes; events 5-12 rest on the MIDIs. The primary slows down during the closing F# only (after the last attack), which lasts 8.348381 source beats in real time.
